result.topic_en: A small table of values of a real polynomial at the integers x = -3…3 and at the complex points x + i, alongside pencil sketches of lemniscate-like closed curves with figure-eight crossings (apparently level curves of the modulus of a polynomial), plus a fan-shaped sketch of arcs and radii.

methods.what: Tabulating the values of a real polynomial (consistent with $3x^4+2x^3-3x^2+3$) at the integers -3 to 3
Evaluating the same polynomial at the complex points x + i, giving complex values
Sketching curves with figure-eight double points, apparently level curves of the modulus of a polynomial (lemniscates) around its roots
